headline: Approved firefighters' collective bargaining agreement and changed allocations of recovery funds for Villano park and Keefe playground repairs.
summary: The committee approved a collective bargaining agreement with IAFF, Local 2687, Hamden Professional Firefighters. It also approved changes to Coronavirus Local Fiscal Recovery Funds, which will pay for repairs at Villano park and the small playground at Keefe Community Center. Both items passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved the collective bargaining agreement between the Town of Hamden and IAFF, Local 2687, unanimously.
Approved further amending and restating allocations of Coronavirus Local Fiscal Recovery Funds for repairs at Villano park and the small playground at Keefe Community Center, unanimously.

1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Administration and Settlement Committee, September 14, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting 
was called to order at 8:08pm with the members noted above in attendance. 
   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to give public comment. 
 
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming Boards and Commission meetings was shared. There were no 
other Board, Committee or Department updates for this evening’s meeting. 
   
4. REGULAR COMMITTEE AGENDA  
  1. ORDER APPROVING A COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEMENT BETWEEN 
THE TOWN OF HAMDEN AND IAFF, LOCAL 2687 HAMDEN PROFESSIONAL 
FIREFIGHTERS 
Motion to open item 4.1 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by 
Council member Osmanu. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions. Item passes unanimously. 
  
  2. ORDER FURTHER AMENDING AND RESTATING ALLOCATIONS OF 
CORONAVIRUS LOCAL FISCAL RECOVERY FUNDS (ALSO KNOWN AS 
AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUNDS) (July 2026) 
Motion to open item 4.2 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by Vice 
Chair Alston.   
Chief of Staff Peterson provided a brief overview noting the funds would be used to 
make repairs at Villano park and the small playground at Keefe Community Center. 
Vote: All in favor; 0 opposed, 0 abstentions. Item passes unanimously.
5. NEW COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s agenda.  
 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the committee, Vice Chair Alston adjourned the meeting at 
8:20pm.
